player_prompt.intro:
Uyiyithonji {player_id} edlala igemu leCheckers njengenkwenkwezi {color}.
Yenza khetho lwakho ngendlela yefomati ya chess [fileRank fileRank], t.f. '[b2c3]' (leteru ya koloni a–h, digitu ya row 0–7).
Iinkonzo ezibasa:
  • Thonjela ngokwezintlobo kushesha ngamanye, uma ilaliwe.
  • Fuduka kuthonjelwa ngokuvuka phezulu kwempahla yedweshu.
  • Inkonzo iyathoniwa uma ifika phezulu kwezinye.
